caption: The drawing depicts a single reddish-brown metal canister with a rounded, rectangular body and two vertical end panels. There are two curved metal handles attached to the top on either side, and a round screw cap situated slightly off-center near the top edge. The canister surface shows areas of darker and lighter brown, as well as some greenish-blue patches and streaks indicating wear and coloration on the metal. The canister is placed against a plain, light beige background and is bordered by a thin rectangular frame drawn in red. In the lower left corner outside the main frame, there is a small sketch of the canister with basic measurement indications. The bottom right of the frame contains a signature and date: "Edward L. Cooper Del. 25.9.91".
title: Copper Foot Warmer
